differential.name: Chronic allograft nephropathy (transplant kidney dysfunction)
differential.rationale: Prior renal transplant with rising creatinine suggests progressive graft injury.

differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy (recurrence in native or transplanted kidney)
differential.rationale: Long‑standing diabetes, proteinuria, microalbuminuria, and CKD are classic for diabetic kidney disease.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Essential hypertension and African‑American race increase risk of hypertension‑related renal damage.

differential.name: Calcineurin inhibitor (e.g., tacrolimus, cyclosporine) nephrotoxicity
differential.rationale: Immunosuppressive therapy post‑transplant commonly causes reversible renal dysfunction.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: CKD stage 1‑2 with documented anemia points to reduced erythropoietin production.
